751-6006-7060.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4677-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
4677-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 green Elemental creature token
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1308-3129-4826-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

2034-5220-7729-7855--180.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat
2034-5220-7729-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1849-3899-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2685-5641-6824-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-5641-6824-7810.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

5641-6890-7743-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6890-7743-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1430-1603-1619.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1430-1603-1619.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Evil Twin and Mirror Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1430-1603-1619.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1263-4871-5075-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-2642-4050-7529.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Studious First-Year // Rampant Growth, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast the prepared spell.
Repeat.

4559-5231-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
4559-5231-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-5220-6961-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1270-2034-5220-6961-7396.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

206-339-677-2292.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

240-1322-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1753-3259-4689.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-4689.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

1879-3259-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
1879-3259-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

628-4050-7214.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

3259-5722-7175.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-5722-7175.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

104-2034-4094-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-2034-4094-5086-5183.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Ley Weaver with "Elf" chosen

1399-1606-4249-7040.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 4.
1399-1606-4249-7040.description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to your devotion to green.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

4659-5220-5741.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
4659-5220-5741.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

261-2577-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
261-2577-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a Spider you control without summoning sickness
attached to the Spider that has Thornbite Staff attached

1013-1729-2178.description:
Activate the Spider with Thornbite Staff and Hypervolt Grasp attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls and destroying it due to the Spider's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shelob and the Spider tapped in step 1 trigger.
Resolve the Shelob trigger, creating a token copy of the creature that died that is a Food artifact.
Resolve the Spider trigger, untapping it.
Repeat as desired. You can also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1170-1171-3499.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-3499.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

1061-2140-6653.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1061-2140-6653.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Ravos triggers, causing you to return a creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fauna Shaman by paying {G}, tapping it and discarding a creature card, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

997-2736-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
997-2736-5434-5555.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

880-2374-3875.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

280-1479-4288.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-4288.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Sarinth Greatwurm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

104-1185-1818-2308-3099.notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
104-1185-1818-2308-3099.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Healer of the Pride triggers, holding priority, activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {1}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 3 life due to Cleric Class.
Prize Pig and Trudge Garden trigger.
Resolve the Prize Pig trigger, putting three ribbon counters of Prize Pig, then removing all ribbon counters from Prize Pig and untapping it.
Resolve the Trudge Garden trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1971-2060-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with power four or greater, or have one exiled by Yannik.
1971-2060-4499.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {3}, blinking Yannik.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, all creatures exiled with it return to the battlefield.
When Yannik enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling another creature you control with power four or greater and putting at least four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2763-2781.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least four loyalty counters on it.
2763-2781.description:
Activate Kaya's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, exiling Felidar Guardian and creating a token copy of it that's a 1/1 Spirit in addition to its other types.
The Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, blinking Kaya.
Repeat.

232-1636-1921.notablePrerequisites:
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two artifact tokens.
232-1636-1921.description:
Activate Tawnos' second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, sacrificing two artifact tokens, and exiling Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
The Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tawnos' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Priest of Urabrask token, and causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite red mana, you may instead choose any other artifact token(s) to make infinite copies of them.

538-2115-2615.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Offspring's Revenge triggers, exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard and creating a 1/1 copy of it with haste.
The Tree of Perdition copy enters the battlefield, triggering Impact Tremors.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition copy by tapping it, exchanging its toughness with target opponent's life total.
Resolve the Impact Tremors trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The opponent whose life total was swapped loses the game due to having zero or les life.

2905-4702.description:
Activate Pestermite by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the token Pestermite enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the nontoken Pestermite.
Repeat.

3990-4019.notablePrerequisites:
Incubation Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a land that can produce {U}.
3990-4019.description:
Activate Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat.

109-3407.manaNeeded: {R}{R}{R}, plus an additional {R} if Dual Strike was not foretold, plus enough mana to cast the additional spell if needed
109-3407.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cast an additional instant or sorcery, or an opponent is casting one.
109-3407.description:
Cast any other instant and/or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Dual Strike by paying {R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast with mana value four or less.
Cast Fork by paying {R}{R}, targeting the instant or sorcery spell cast in step 1.
Dual Strike triggers, copying Fork, with the copy targeting the original Fork.
Resolve the copy of Fork, copying Fork, with the copy targeting the original Fork.
Repeat step 5.
